1/*!
2A memory-safe, pure-Rust JBIG2 decoder.
3
4`hayro-jbig2` decodes JBIG2 images as specified in ITU-T T.88 (also known as
5ISO/IEC 14492). JBIG2 is a bi-level image compression standard commonly used
6in PDF documents for compressing scanned text documents.
7
8The crate is `no_std` compatible but requires an allocator to be available.
9
10# Safety
11This crate forbids unsafe code via a crate-level attribute.
12*/
13
14#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
15#![allow(missing_docs)]

23/// A reusable context for decoding JBIG2 images.
24#[derive(Default)]
25pub struct DecoderContext {
26    pub(crate) page_state: PageState,
27    pub(crate) scratch_buffers: ScratchBuffers,
28    pub(crate) page_bitmap: Bitmap,
29}

32pub(crate) struct ScratchBuffers {

36/// A decoder for JBIG2 images.
37pub trait Decoder {
38    /// Push a single pixel to the output.
39    fn push_pixel(&mut self, black: bool);
40    /// Push multiple chunks of 8 pixels of the same color.
41    ///
42    /// The `chunk_count` parameter indicates how many 8-pixel chunks to push.
43    /// For example, if this method is called with `white = true` and
44    /// `chunk_count = 10`, 80 white pixels are pushed (10 × 8 = 80).
45    ///
46    /// You can assume that this method is only called if the number of already
47    /// pushed pixels is a multiple of 8 (i.e. byte-aligned).
48    fn push_pixel_chunk(&mut self, black: bool, chunk_count: u32);
49    /// Called when a row has been completed.
50    fn next_line(&mut self);
51}

92/// A JBIG2 image.
93pub struct Image<'a> {
94    /// The parsed segments.
95    segments: Vec<segment::Segment<'a>>,
96    /// The width of the image in pixels.
97    width: u32,
98    /// The height of the image in pixels.
99    height: u32,
100    /// The height determined from `EndOfStripe` segments, if applicable.
101    height_from_stripes: Option<u32>,
102}
103
104impl<'a> Image<'a> {
105    /// Parse a JBIG2 file from the given data.
106    ///
107    /// The file is expected to use the sequential or random-access organization,
108    /// as defined in Annex D.1 and D.2.
109    pub fn new(data: &'a [u8]) -> Result<Self> {
110        let file = parse_file(data)?;
111        Self::from_segments(file.segments)
112    }
113
114    /// Parse an embedded JBIG2 image with optional global segments.
115    ///
116    /// The file is expected to use the embedded organization defined in
117    /// Annex D.3. PdfCraft patch (17): data that starts with a file header (D.4)
118    /// is read past it, in the organization it declares, as Acrobat and PDFBox
119    /// draw such streams; its segments still count together with the globals'.
120    pub fn new_embedded(data: &'a [u8], globals: Option<&'a [u8]>) -> Result<Self> {
121        let mut segments = Vec::new();
122        let mut count = SegmentCount::default();
123        if let Some(globals_data) = globals {
124            let mut reader = Reader::new(globals_data);
125            parse_segments_sequential(&mut reader, &mut segments, &mut count)?;
126        };
127
128        match after_file_header(data)? {
129            Some((mut reader, FileOrganization::RandomAccess)) => {
130                parse_segments_random_access(&mut reader, &mut segments, &mut count)?;
131            }
132            Some((mut reader, FileOrganization::Sequential)) => {
133                parse_segments_sequential(&mut reader, &mut segments, &mut count)?;
134            }
135            None => {
136                let mut reader = Reader::new(data);
137                parse_segments_sequential(&mut reader, &mut segments, &mut count)?;
138            }
139        }
140
141        segments.sort_by_key(|seg| seg.header.segment_number);
142
143        Self::from_segments(segments)
144    }
145
146    fn from_segments(segments: Vec<segment::Segment<'a>>) -> Result<Self> {
147        // Pre-scan for stripe height from EndOfStripe segments.
148        let height_from_stripes = segments
149            .iter()
150            .filter(|seg| seg.header.segment_type == SegmentType::EndOfStripe)
151            .filter_map(|seg| u32::from_be_bytes(seg.data.try_into().ok()?).checked_add(1))
152            .max();
153
154        // Find and parse page information to extract dimensions.
155        let page_info_seg = segments.iter().find(|s| s.header.segment_type == SegmentType::PageInformation).ok_or(FormatError::MissingPageInfo)?;
156
157        let mut reader = Reader::new(page_info_seg.data);
158        let page_info = parse_page_information(&mut reader)?;
159
160        // "A page's bitmap height may be declared in its page information segment
161        // to be unknown (by specifying a height of 0xFFFFFFFF). In this case, the
162        // page must be striped." (7.4.8.2)
163        let height = if page_info.height == 0xFFFF_FFFF { height_from_stripes.ok_or(FormatError::UnknownPageHeight)? } else { page_info.height };
164
165        if page_info.width == 0 || height == 0 {
166            bail!(FormatError::EmptyPage);
167        }
168        bitmap::check_page_size(page_info.width, height)?;
169
170        Ok(Self { segments, width: page_info.width, height, height_from_stripes })
171    }
172
173    /// The width of the image in pixels.
174    pub fn width(&self) -> u32 {
175        self.width
176    }
177
178    /// The height of the image in pixels.
179    pub fn height(&self) -> u32 {
180        self.height
181    }
182
183    /// Decode the image data through the given [`Decoder`].
184    pub fn decode<D: Decoder>(&self, decoder: &mut D) -> Result<()> {
185        let mut ctx = DecoderContext::default();
186
187        self.decode_with(decoder, &mut ctx)
188    }
189
190    /// Decode the image data through the given [`Decoder`] and [`DecoderContext`].
191    ///
192    /// This is useful in case you want to convert multiple JBIG2 images,
193    /// as it allows `hayro-jbig2` to reuse allocations during decoding.
194    pub fn decode_with<D: Decoder>(&self, decoder: &mut D, ctx: &mut DecoderContext) -> Result<()> {
195        let mut work_left = bitmap::MAX_WORK;
196        decode_segments(&self.segments, self.height_from_stripes, ctx, &mut work_left)?;
197        emit_bitmap(&ctx.page_bitmap, decoder);
198
199        Ok(())
200    }
201
202    /// PdfCraft patch: [`Image::decode`], spending from `work`, what decoding may still cost
203    /// across a run of images. An image spends what it took, failing or not, starting with its
204    /// page's pixels, which whoever asked for them will go through, and its segments, so images
205    /// that decode nothing add up too. On top of that, it takes at most [`bitmap::MAX_WORK`]
206    /// whatever `work` says. One that `work` can't pay for spends all of it, so a run ends rather
207    /// than trying every image it has left. Reading the stream comes before this and is charged
208    /// by [`charge_reading`].
209    pub fn decode_within<D: Decoder>(&self, decoder: &mut D, work: &mut u64) -> Result<()> {
210        let start = bitmap::decode_work(self.width, self.height).saturating_add(self.segments.len() as u64);
211        if charge_work(work, start).is_err() {
212            *work = 0;
213            bail!(OverflowError::DecodingWork);
214        }
215        let allowed = bitmap::MAX_WORK.min(*work);
216        let mut left = allowed;
217        let mut ctx = DecoderContext::default();
218        let decoded = decode_segments(&self.segments, self.height_from_stripes, &mut ctx, &mut left);
219        let refused = decoded == Err(OverflowError::DecodingWork.into());
220        *work = if refused && allowed < bitmap::MAX_WORK { 0 } else { *work - (allowed - left) };
221        decoded?;
222        emit_bitmap(&ctx.page_bitmap, &mut *decoder);
223
224        Ok(())
225    }
226}
227
228fn emit_bitmap<D: Decoder>(bitmap: &Bitmap, decoder: &mut D) {
229    let width = bitmap.width;
230    let bytes_per_row = width.div_ceil(8) as usize;
231
232    for row in bitmap.data.chunks_exact(bitmap.stride as usize) {
233        let mut x = 0_u32;
234        let mut chunk_byte: Option<u8> = None;
235        let mut chunk_count = 0_u32;
236
237        let bytes = row.iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_be_bytes()).take(bytes_per_row);
238
239        for byte in bytes {
240            let remaining = width - x;
241
242            if remaining >= 8 && (byte == 0x00 || byte == 0xFF) {
243                // Continue the previous chunk.
244                if chunk_byte == Some(byte) {
245                    chunk_count += 1;
246                    x += 8;
247                    continue;
248                }
249
250                // Flush previous chunk if any, then start new one.
251                if let Some(b) = chunk_byte {
252                    decoder.push_pixel_chunk(b == 0xFF, chunk_count);
253                }
254
255                chunk_byte = Some(byte);
256                chunk_count = 1;
257                x += 8;
258
259                continue;
260            }
261
262            // Can't continue/start chunk, flush any existing chunk first.
263            if let Some(b) = chunk_byte.take() {
264                decoder.push_pixel_chunk(b == 0xFF, chunk_count);
265                chunk_count = 0;
266            }
267
268            // Emit individual pixels.
269            let count = remaining.min(8);
270            for i in 0..count {
271                decoder.push_pixel((byte >> (7 - i)) & 1 != 0);
272            }
273            x += count;
274        }
275
276        // Flush any remaining chunk at end of row.
277        if let Some(b) = chunk_byte {
278            decoder.push_pixel_chunk(b == 0xFF, chunk_count);
279        }
280
281        decoder.next_line();
282    }
283}

285/// PdfCraft patch: count `work` more decoding work, refusing past what is `left` of
286/// [`bitmap::MAX_WORK`] or a run's allowance before what asks for it is decoded.
287fn charge_work(left: &mut u64, work: u64) -> Result<()> {
288    *left = left.checked_sub(work).ok_or(OverflowError::DecodingWork)?;
289    Ok(())
290}
291
292/// PdfCraft patch: the steps of reading a byte of a stream or its globals: parsing and sorting
293/// segments, and building their tables, measured at about 3 a byte at the worst.
294const READ_WORK: u64 = 4;
295
296/// PdfCraft patch: charge `work`, what a run of images may still cost, for reading `bytes` of a stream
297/// and its globals. This comes before anything is parsed, as it counts whether or not they turn out
298/// to decode: an image that fails has still cost its reading, and it is read again for each use. What
299/// `work` can't pay for spends all of it.
300pub fn charge_reading(work: &mut u64, bytes: usize) -> Result<()> {
301    if charge_work(work, (bytes as u64).saturating_mul(READ_WORK)).is_err() {
302        *work = 0;
303        bail!(OverflowError::DecodingWork);
304    }
305    Ok(())
306}
307
308/// PdfCraft patch: the work of a region decoded pixel by pixel.
309fn region_work(region: &decode::RegionSegmentInfo) -> u64 {
310    bitmap::decode_work(region.width, region.height)
311}
312
313/// PdfCraft patch: the page restricted to a refinement's area, its reference when it refers to no
314/// other region (7.4.7.4). Copying it a word at a time costs less than the region's own decoding,
315/// already charged, and it is held, as large as the region, only while the region decodes.
316fn page_area(page: &Bitmap, region: &decode::RegionSegmentInfo) -> Result<Bitmap> {
317    page.area(region.x_location, region.y_location, region.width, region.height)
318}
319
320fn decode_segments(
321    segments: &[segment::Segment<'_>],
322    height_from_stripes: Option<u32>,
323    decoder_ctx: &mut DecoderContext,
324    work_left: &mut u64,
325) -> Result<()> {
326    // Find and parse page information segment first.
327    if let Some(page_info) = segments.iter().find(|s| s.header.segment_type == SegmentType::PageInformation) {
328        let mut reader = Reader::new(page_info.data);
329        init_page(&mut reader, height_from_stripes, &mut decoder_ctx.page_state, &mut decoder_ctx.page_bitmap)?;
330    } else {
331        bail!(FormatError::MissingPageInfo);
332    }
333
334    let page_bitmap = &mut decoder_ctx.page_bitmap;
335    let page_state = &mut decoder_ctx.page_state;
336    let scratch_buffers = &mut decoder_ctx.scratch_buffers;
337
338    // Process all segments.
339    for seg in segments {
340        let mut reader = Reader::new(seg.data);
341
342        match seg.header.segment_type {
343            SegmentType::PageInformation => {
344                // Already processed above, skip.
345            }
346            SegmentType::ImmediateGenericRegion | SegmentType::ImmediateLosslessGenericRegion => {
347                let had_unknown_length = seg.header.data_length.is_none();
348                let header = generic::parse(&mut reader, had_unknown_length)?;
349                charge_work(work_left, region_work(&header.region_info))?;
350
351                if page_state.can_decode_directly(page_bitmap, &header.region_info, false) {
352                    generic::decode_into(&header, page_bitmap, scratch_buffers)?;
353                } else {
354                    let region = generic::decode(&header, scratch_buffers)?;
355                    page_bitmap.combine_region(&region.bitmap, region.combination_operator);
356                }
357                page_state.page_pristine = false;
358            }
359            SegmentType::IntermediateGenericRegion => {
360                // Intermediate segments cannot have unknown length.
361                let header = generic::parse(&mut reader, false)?;
362                charge_work(work_left, region_work(&header.region_info))?;
363                let region = generic::decode(&header, scratch_buffers)?;
364                page_state.store_region(seg.header.segment_number, region.bitmap)?;
365            }
366            SegmentType::PatternDictionary => {
367                let header = pattern::parse(&mut reader)?;
368                charge_work(work_left, header.work())?;
369                let dictionary = pattern::decode(&header, scratch_buffers, page_state.retained_room())?;
370                page_state.store_pattern_dictionary(seg.header.segment_number, dictionary)?;
371            }
372            SegmentType::SymbolDictionary => {
373                // "1) Concatenate all the input symbol dictionaries to form SDINSYMS."
374                // (6.5.5, step 1)
375                // Collect references to avoid cloning; symbols are only cloned if re-exported.
376                let input_symbols = page_state.referred_symbols(&seg.header.referred_to_segments)?;
377                charge_work(work_left, input_symbols.len() as u64)?;
378
379                // Collect Huffman tables from referred table segments.
380                let referred_tables: Vec<HuffmanTable> =
381                    seg.header.referred_to_segments.iter().filter_map(|&num| page_state.get_huffman_table(num)).cloned().collect();
382
383                // Get retained contexts from the last referred symbol dictionary (7.4.2.2 step 3).
384                let retained_contexts = seg
385                    .header
386                    .referred_to_segments
387                    .last()
388                    .and_then(|&num| page_state.get_symbol_dictionary(num))
389                    .and_then(|dict| dict.retained_contexts.as_ref());
390
391                let header = symbol::parse(&mut reader)?;
392                let dictionary = symbol::decode(
393                    &header,
394                    &input_symbols,
395                    &referred_tables,
396                    &page_state.standard_tables,
397                    retained_contexts,
398                    page_state.retained_room(),
399                    work_left,
400                )?;
401                page_state.store_symbol_dictionary(seg.header.segment_number, dictionary)?;
402            }
403            SegmentType::ImmediateTextRegion | SegmentType::ImmediateLosslessTextRegion => {
404                // Collect symbols from referred symbol dictionaries (SBSYMS).
405                let symbols = page_state.referred_symbols(&seg.header.referred_to_segments)?;
406                charge_work(work_left, symbols.len() as u64)?;
407
408                // Collect Huffman tables from referred table segments.
409                // "These user-supplied Huffman decoding tables may be supplied either
410                // as a Tables segment..." (7.4.3.1.6)
411                let referred_tables: Vec<HuffmanTable> =
412                    seg.header.referred_to_segments.iter().filter_map(|&num| page_state.get_huffman_table(num)).cloned().collect();
413
414                let header = text::parse(&mut reader, symbols.len() as u32)?;
415                charge_work(work_left, bitmap::copy_work(header.region_info.width, header.region_info.height))?;
416                if header.flags.use_huffman {
417                    // Its symbol ID table has a line for each symbol.
418                    charge_work(work_left, (symbols.len() as u64).saturating_mul(bitmap::HUFFMAN_LINE_WORK))?;
419                }
420
421                if page_state.can_decode_directly(page_bitmap, &header.region_info, header.flags.default_pixel) {
422                    text::decode_into(&header, &symbols, &referred_tables, &page_state.standard_tables, page_bitmap, scratch_buffers, work_left)?;
423                } else {
424                    let region = text::decode(&header, &symbols, &referred_tables, &page_state.standard_tables, scratch_buffers, work_left)?;
425                    page_bitmap.combine_region(&region.bitmap, region.combination_operator);
426                }
427                page_state.page_pristine = false;
428            }
429            SegmentType::IntermediateTextRegion => {
430                // Collect symbols from referred symbol dictionaries (SBSYMS).
431                let symbols = page_state.referred_symbols(&seg.header.referred_to_segments)?;
432                charge_work(work_left, symbols.len() as u64)?;
433
434                // Collect Huffman tables from referred table segments.
435                let referred_tables: Vec<HuffmanTable> =
436                    seg.header.referred_to_segments.iter().filter_map(|&num| page_state.get_huffman_table(num)).cloned().collect();
437
438                let header = text::parse(&mut reader, symbols.len() as u32)?;
439                charge_work(work_left, bitmap::copy_work(header.region_info.width, header.region_info.height))?;
440                if header.flags.use_huffman {
441                    // Its symbol ID table has a line for each symbol.
442                    charge_work(work_left, (symbols.len() as u64).saturating_mul(bitmap::HUFFMAN_LINE_WORK))?;
443                }
444                let region = text::decode(&header, &symbols, &referred_tables, &page_state.standard_tables, scratch_buffers, work_left)?;
445                page_state.store_region(seg.header.segment_number, region.bitmap)?;
446            }
447            SegmentType::ImmediateHalftoneRegion | SegmentType::ImmediateLosslessHalftoneRegion => {
448                let pattern_dict = seg
449                    .header
450                    .referred_to_segments
451                    .first()
452                    .and_then(|&num| page_state.get_pattern_dictionary(num))
453                    .ok_or(SegmentError::MissingPatternDictionary)?;
454
455                let header = halftone::parse(&mut reader)?;
456                charge_work(work_left, halftone::work(&header, pattern_dict))?;
457
458                if page_state.can_decode_directly(page_bitmap, &header.region_info, header.flags.initial_pixel_color) {
459                    halftone::decode_into(&header, pattern_dict, page_bitmap, scratch_buffers)?;
460                } else {
461                    let region = halftone::decode(&header, pattern_dict, scratch_buffers)?;
462                    page_bitmap.combine_region(&region.bitmap, region.combination_operator);
463                }
464                page_state.page_pristine = false;
465            }
466            SegmentType::IntermediateHalftoneRegion => {
467                let pattern_dict = seg
468                    .header
469                    .referred_to_segments
470                    .first()
471                    .and_then(|&num| page_state.get_pattern_dictionary(num))
472                    .ok_or(SegmentError::MissingPatternDictionary)?;
473
474                let header = halftone::parse(&mut reader)?;
475                charge_work(work_left, halftone::work(&header, pattern_dict))?;
476                let region = halftone::decode(&header, pattern_dict, scratch_buffers)?;
477                page_state.store_region(seg.header.segment_number, region.bitmap)?;
478            }
479            SegmentType::IntermediateGenericRefinementRegion => {
480                // Same logic as immediate refinement, but store result instead of combining.
481                let referred_segment = seg.header.referred_to_segments.first().and_then(|&num| page_state.get_referred_segment(num));
482
483                let header = generic_refinement::parse(&mut reader)?;
484                charge_work(work_left, region_work(&header.region_info))?;
485                // PdfCraft patch: a refinement of the page refines its area (`Bitmap::area`).
486                let area;
487                let reference = match referred_segment {
488                    Some(region) => region,
489                    None => {
490                        area = page_area(page_bitmap, &header.region_info)?;
491                        &area
492                    }
493                };
494                let region = generic_refinement::decode(&header, reference, scratch_buffers)?;
495                page_state.store_region(seg.header.segment_number, region.bitmap)?;
496            }
497            SegmentType::ImmediateGenericRefinementRegion | SegmentType::ImmediateLosslessGenericRefinementRegion => {
498                // "3) Determine the buffer associated with the region segment that
499                // this segment refers to." (7.4.7.5)
500                //
501                // With no region segment referred to, the reference is the page restricted to
502                // this segment's area (7.4.7.4).
503                let referred_segment = seg.header.referred_to_segments.first().and_then(|&num| page_state.get_referred_segment(num));
504
505                let header = generic_refinement::parse(&mut reader)?;
506                charge_work(work_left, region_work(&header.region_info))?;
507
508                if let Some(referred_segment) = referred_segment
509                    && page_state.can_decode_directly(page_bitmap, &header.region_info, false)
510                {
511                    generic_refinement::decode_into(&header, referred_segment, page_bitmap, scratch_buffers)?;
512                } else {
513                    // PdfCraft patch: a refinement of the page refines its area (`Bitmap::area`).
514                    let area;
515                    let reference = match referred_segment {
516                        Some(region) => region,
517                        None => {
518                            area = page_area(page_bitmap, &header.region_info)?;
519                            &area
520                        }
521                    };
522                    let region = generic_refinement::decode(&header, reference, scratch_buffers)?;
523                    page_bitmap.combine_region(&region.bitmap, region.combination_operator);
524                }
525                page_state.page_pristine = false;
526            }
527            SegmentType::Tables => {
528                // "Tables – see 7.4.13." (type 53)
529                // "This segment contains data which defines one or more user-supplied
530                // Huffman coding tables." (7.4.13)
531                let table = HuffmanTable::read_custom(&mut reader)?;
532                page_state.store_huffman_table(seg.header.segment_number, table)?;
533            }
534            SegmentType::EndOfPage | SegmentType::EndOfFile => {
535                break;
536            }
537            // Other segment types not yet implemented.
538            _ => {}
539        }
540    }
541
542    Ok(())
543}

545/// PdfCraft patch: the words a stored item costs in its list, at least, apart from what it holds.
546const ENTRY_WORDS: u64 = 32;
547
548/// PdfCraft patch: the most words a page's segments may hold for later ones, 64 MiB: two square
549/// bitmaps of 16,384 a side (`bitmap::MAX_PIXELS`). Each stored item is bounded on its own, but without a
550/// bound on all of them a stream of a few dozen bytes a segment held 33 MB each (a 16,384-sample
551/// square region of typical rows), and a few kilobytes could exhaust memory. A segment being
552/// decoded takes more for a while, within its own bounds: the page bitmap isn't counted, nor is
553/// what a region or a grid uses until it is stored or freed.
554const MAX_RETAINED_WORDS: u64 = 2 * (bitmap::MAX_PIXELS / bitmap::WORD_BITS as u64 + bitmap::BITMAP_WORDS as u64 + ENTRY_WORDS);
555
556/// PdfCraft patch: the most symbols one segment may refer to, 2^20, far beyond the 65,535 a
557/// dictionary may export. References may repeat, so each names the same symbols again: without
558/// this, 65,535 references to one dictionary in a 78 KB stream collected 17 GB of pointers.
559const MAX_REFERRED_SYMBOLS: u64 = 1 << 20;
560
561/// Page-level decoding state for a JBIG2 page.
562#[derive(Default)]
563pub(crate) struct PageState {
564    /// The parsed page information.
565    pub(crate) page_info: PageInformation,
566    /// Whether the page bitmap is still in its initial state (not yet painted to).
567    pub(crate) page_pristine: bool,
568    /// Decoded intermediate regions, stored as (`segment_number`, region) pairs.
569    pub(crate) referred_segments: Vec<(u32, Bitmap)>,
570    /// Decoded pattern dictionaries, stored as (`segment_number`, dictionary) pairs.
571    pub(crate) pattern_dictionaries: Vec<(u32, PatternDictionary)>,
572    /// Decoded symbol dictionaries, stored as (`segment_number`, dictionary) pairs.
573    pub(crate) symbol_dictionaries: Vec<(u32, SymbolDictionary)>,
574    /// Decoded Huffman tables from table segments, stored as (`segment_number`, table) pairs.
575    /// "Tables – see 7.4.13." (type 53)
576    pub(crate) huffman_tables: Vec<(u32, HuffmanTable)>,
577    /// PdfCraft patch: the words the regions, dictionaries and tables above hold, at most
578    /// [`MAX_RETAINED_WORDS`].
579    pub(crate) retained_words: u64,
580    /// Standard Huffman tables (`TABLE_A` through `TABLE_O`).
581    pub(crate) standard_tables: StandardHuffmanTables,
582}
583
584impl PageState {
585    fn reset(&mut self, page_info: PageInformation) {
586        self.page_info = page_info;
587        self.page_pristine = true;
588        self.referred_segments.clear();
589        self.pattern_dictionaries.clear();
590        self.symbol_dictionaries.clear();
591        self.huffman_tables.clear();
592        self.retained_words = 0;
593        // Standard tables are lazily built and reused across images.
594    }
595
596    /// Check if an immediate region can be decoded directly into the page bitmap.
597    fn can_decode_directly(&self, page_bitmap: &Bitmap, region_info: &decode::RegionSegmentInfo, region_default_pixel: bool) -> bool {
598        if !self.page_pristine {
599            return false;
600        }
601
602        let covers_page = region_info.x_location == 0
603            && region_info.y_location == 0
604            && region_info.width == page_bitmap.width
605            && region_info.height == page_bitmap.height;
606
607        if !covers_page {
608            return false;
609        }
610
611        let page_default_is_zero = self.page_info.flags.default_pixel == 0;
612
613        if region_default_pixel == page_default_is_zero {
614            return false;
615        }
616
617        let op = region_info.combination_operator;
618        match op {
619            CombinationOperator::Replace => true,
620            CombinationOperator::Or | CombinationOperator::Xor => page_default_is_zero,
621            CombinationOperator::And | CombinationOperator::Xnor => !page_default_is_zero,
622        }
623    }
624
625    /// PdfCraft patch: the words the page may still hold for later segments.
626    fn retained_room(&self) -> u64 {
627        MAX_RETAINED_WORDS.saturating_sub(self.retained_words)
628    }
629
630    /// PdfCraft patch: count a stored item holding `words` for later segments, refusing past
631    /// [`MAX_RETAINED_WORDS`].
632    fn retain(&mut self, words: usize) -> Result<()> {
633        self.retained_words = self.retained_words.saturating_add(words as u64).saturating_add(ENTRY_WORDS);
634        if self.retained_words > MAX_RETAINED_WORDS {
635            bail!(OverflowError::RetainedBitmaps);
636        }
637        Ok(())
638    }
639
640    /// Store a decoded region for later reference.
641    fn store_region(&mut self, segment_number: u32, region: Bitmap) -> Result<()> {
642        self.retain(region.words())?;
643        self.referred_segments.push((segment_number, region));
644        Ok(())
645    }
646
647    /// Look up a referred segment by number.
648    fn get_referred_segment(&self, segment_number: u32) -> Option<&Bitmap> {
649        self.referred_segments.binary_search_by_key(&segment_number, |(num, _)| *num).ok().map(|idx| &self.referred_segments[idx].1)
650    }
651
652    /// Store a decoded pattern dictionary for later reference.
653    fn store_pattern_dictionary(&mut self, segment_number: u32, dictionary: PatternDictionary) -> Result<()> {
654        self.retain(dictionary.words())?;
655        self.pattern_dictionaries.push((segment_number, dictionary));
656        Ok(())
657    }
658
659    /// Look up a pattern dictionary by segment number.
660    fn get_pattern_dictionary(&self, segment_number: u32) -> Option<&PatternDictionary> {
661        self.pattern_dictionaries.binary_search_by_key(&segment_number, |(num, _)| *num).ok().map(|idx| &self.pattern_dictionaries[idx].1)
662    }
663
664    /// Store a decoded symbol dictionary for later reference.
665    fn store_symbol_dictionary(&mut self, segment_number: u32, dictionary: SymbolDictionary) -> Result<()> {
666        self.retain(dictionary.words())?;
667        self.symbol_dictionaries.push((segment_number, dictionary));
668        Ok(())
669    }
670
671    /// PdfCraft patch: the symbols of the dictionaries in `segments`, in order, refusing past
672    /// [`MAX_REFERRED_SYMBOLS`] before anything is collected.
673    fn referred_symbols(&self, segments: &[u32]) -> Result<Vec<&Bitmap>> {
674        let dictionaries = || segments.iter().filter_map(|&num| self.get_symbol_dictionary(num));
675        let count = dictionaries().map(|dictionary| dictionary.exported_symbols.len() as u64).fold(0, u64::saturating_add);
676        if count > MAX_REFERRED_SYMBOLS {
677            bail!(OverflowError::SymbolCount);
678        }
679        Ok(dictionaries().flat_map(|dictionary| dictionary.exported_symbols.iter()).collect())
680    }
681
682    /// Look up a symbol dictionary by segment number.
683    fn get_symbol_dictionary(&self, segment_number: u32) -> Option<&SymbolDictionary> {
684        self.symbol_dictionaries.binary_search_by_key(&segment_number, |(num, _)| *num).ok().map(|idx| &self.symbol_dictionaries[idx].1)
685    }
686
687    /// Store a decoded Huffman table for later reference.
688    fn store_huffman_table(&mut self, segment_number: u32, table: HuffmanTable) -> Result<()> {
689        self.retain(table.words())?;
690        self.huffman_tables.push((segment_number, table));
691        Ok(())
692    }
693
694    /// Look up a Huffman table by segment number.
695    fn get_huffman_table(&self, segment_number: u32) -> Option<&HuffmanTable> {
696        self.huffman_tables.binary_search_by_key(&segment_number, |(num, _)| *num).ok().map(|idx| &self.huffman_tables[idx].1)
697    }
698}
699
700/// Parse page information and initialize the page bitmap.
701fn init_page(reader: &mut Reader<'_>, height_from_stripes: Option<u32>, page: &mut PageState, bitmap: &mut Bitmap) -> Result<()> {
702    let page_info = parse_page_information(reader)?;
703
704    // "A page's bitmap height may be declared in its page information segment
705    // to be unknown (by specifying a height of 0xFFFFFFFF). In this case, the
706    // page must be striped." (7.4.8.2)
707    let height = if page_info.height == 0xFFFF_FFFF { height_from_stripes.ok_or(FormatError::UnknownPageHeight)? } else { page_info.height };
708
709    // "Bit 2: Page default pixel value. This bit contains the initial value
710    // for every pixel in the page, before any region segments are decoded
711    // or drawn." (7.4.8.5)
712    bitmap.reinitialize(page_info.width, height, page_info.flags.default_pixel != 0)?;
713
714    page.reset(page_info);
715
716    Ok(())
717}
718
719#[cfg(any())]
720mod tests {
721    use super::*;
722
723    /// A page past the bounds is refused when the stream is opened, since callers size their
724    /// output from it before decoding starts. 16,384 squared is exactly the bound on pixels.
725    #[cfg(any())]
726    fn a_page_past_the_bounds_is_refused_when_opened() {
727        let stream = |width: u32, height: u32| {
728            let mut stream = vec![0, 0, 0, 0, 48, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 19];
729            stream.extend_from_slice(&width.to_be_bytes());
730            stream.extend_from_slice(&height.to_be_bytes());
731            stream.extend_from_slice(&[0; 11]); // resolution, flags, striping
732            stream
733        };
734        assert!(Image::new_embedded(&stream(16384, 16384), None).is_ok());
735        assert!(Image::new_embedded(&stream(16385, 16384), None).is_err());
736        assert!(Image::new_embedded(&stream(65536, 1), None).is_err(), "too wide, though few pixels");
737        assert!(Image::new_embedded(&stream(1 << 20, 1 << 20), None).is_err());
738    }
739
740    /// Segment `number` of `kind` on page 1, referring to `refers_to`.
741    fn segment(number: u8, kind: u8, refers_to: &[u8], data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
742        let mut segment = vec![0, 0, 0, number, kind, (refers_to.len() as u8) << 5];
743        segment.extend_from_slice(refers_to);
744        segment.push(1);
745        segment.extend_from_slice(&(data.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
746        segment.extend_from_slice(data);
747        segment
748    }
749
750    /// A blank page of 8 × 8: resolution unknown, flags, not striped.
751    fn page_of_8() -> Vec<u8> {
752        segment(0, 48, &[], &[0, 0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x42, 0, 0])
753    }
754
755    /// Region information (7.4.1) of 4 × 4 at `x`, `y`, then the region's own `header`, then
756    /// arbitrary coded data.
757    fn region_of_4(x: u32, y: u32, operator: u8, header: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
758        let mut data: Vec<u8> = [4u32, 4, x, y].iter().flat_map(|v| v.to_be_bytes()).collect();
759        data.push(operator);
760        data.extend_from_slice(header);
761        data.extend_from_slice(&[0x5a; 16]);
762        data
763    }
764
765    const GENERIC: &[u8] = &[0, 3, 0xFF, 0xFD, 0xFF, 2, 0xFE, 0xFE, 0xFE]; // template 0, AT
766    const REFINEMENT: &[u8] = &[0, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF]; // template 0, AT
767    const OR: u8 = 0;
768    const REPLACE: u8 = 4;
769
770    /// PdfCraft patch: a region's location is unsigned (5.4.4), so one past `i32::MAX` is off the
771    /// page. Taken for a signed one, a region at 0xFFFFFFFE drew back onto the page two pixels left
772    /// of it, and a refinement there was refused, and the rest of the stream with it. Each region
773    /// here is 4 × 4 on a blank page of 8 × 8, its coded data arbitrary: on the page it draws, off
774    /// it nothing.
775    #[cfg(any())]
776    fn a_region_located_past_i32_max_is_off_the_page() {
777        struct Ink(u32);
778        impl Decoder for Ink {
779            fn push_pixel(&mut self, black: bool) {
780                self.0 += u32::from(black);
781            }
782            fn push_pixel_chunk(&mut self, black: bool, chunks: u32) {
783                self.0 += if black { 8 * chunks } else { 0 };
784            }
785            fn next_line(&mut self) {}
786        }
787        let ink = |x: u32, y: u32| {
788            let forms = [
789                // An immediate generic region.
790                vec![segment(1, 38, &[], &region_of_4(x, y, OR, GENERIC))],
791                // An immediate refinement of the page, which reads the page at its own location (7.4.7.4).
792                vec![segment(1, 42, &[], &region_of_4(x, y, REPLACE, REFINEMENT))],
793                // An immediate refinement of an intermediate region at the same place (7.4.7.5).
794                vec![segment(1, 36, &[], &region_of_4(x, y, OR, GENERIC)), segment(2, 42, &[1], &region_of_4(x, y, OR, REFINEMENT))],
795            ];
796            forms.map(|form| {
797                let stream = [page_of_8(), form.concat()].concat();
798                let mut ink = Ink(0);
799                Image::new_embedded(&stream, None).and_then(|image| image.decode(&mut ink)).map(|()| ink.0)
800            })
801        };
802        for (x, y) in [(0, 0), (2, 2)] {
803            assert!(ink(x, y).iter().all(|ink| matches!(ink, Ok(n) if *n > 0)), "{x}, {y}: {:?}", ink(x, y));
804        }
805        for (x, y) in [(0xFFFF_FFFE, 0), (0, 0xFFFF_FFFE), (0x8000_0000, 0x8000_0000), (u32::MAX, u32::MAX)] {
806            assert_eq!(ink(x, y).map(|ink| ink.ok()), [Some(0); 3], "{x:#x}, {y:#x}");
807        }
808    }
809
810    /// PdfCraft patch: a refinement of a region refines it where it is, "GRREFERENCEDX 0,
811    /// GRREFERENCEDY 0" (Table 35), not the page at the refinement's location. A region and its
812    /// refinement, directly or through an intermediate refinement, decode otherwise than the same
813    /// refinements of the page, and at 2, 3 to the pixels they decode to at 0, 0, moved.
814    #[cfg(any())]
815    fn a_refinement_of_a_region_decodes_the_same_wherever_they_are() {
816        #[derive(Default)]
817        struct Pixels(Vec<bool>);
818        impl Decoder for Pixels {
819            fn push_pixel(&mut self, black: bool) {
820                self.0.push(black);
821            }
822            fn push_pixel_chunk(&mut self, black: bool, chunks: u32) {
823                self.0.extend((0..8 * chunks).map(|_| black));
824            }
825            fn next_line(&mut self) {}
826        }
827        // The first refinement refers to the region before it, or `of_page`, to nothing: the page.
828        let decode = |x: u32, y: u32, through_intermediate: bool, of_page: bool| {
829            let first: &[u8] = if of_page { &[] } else { &[1] };
830            let mut form = vec![segment(1, 36, &[], &region_of_4(x, y, OR, GENERIC))];
831            if through_intermediate {
832                form.push(segment(2, 40, first, &region_of_4(x, y, OR, REFINEMENT)));
833                form.push(segment(3, 42, &[2], &region_of_4(x, y, OR, REFINEMENT)));
834            } else {
835                form.push(segment(2, 42, first, &region_of_4(x, y, OR, REFINEMENT)));
836            }
837            let stream = [page_of_8(), form.concat()].concat();
838            let mut pixels = Pixels::default();
839            Image::new_embedded(&stream, None).unwrap().decode(&mut pixels).unwrap();
840            pixels.0
841        };
842        for through_intermediate in [false, true] {
843            let at_origin = decode(0, 0, through_intermediate, false);
844            assert!(at_origin.contains(&true), "draws");
845            assert_ne!(at_origin, decode(0, 0, through_intermediate, true), "the page refined instead");
846            for (i, &black) in decode(2, 3, through_intermediate, false).iter().enumerate() {
847                let (x, y) = (i % 8, i / 8);
848                let moved = x >= 2 && y >= 3 && at_origin[(y - 3) * 8 + x - 2];
849                assert_eq!(black, moved, "{x}, {y}, through an intermediate refinement: {through_intermediate}");
850            }
851        }
852    }
853
854    /// PdfCraft patch: a refinement of the page refines the page restricted to its area (7.4.7.4),
855    /// reading 0 around it, and a reference 32 or more left of a refinement is read from where each
856    /// row starts in it. So that a context read wrong changes what decodes, the refinements are
857    /// large, and their pictures come from the hash they were coded from: a 64 × 16 refinement at
858    /// 41, 4 of a 112 × 24 page, and a 70 × 12 text instance refined from a 140 × 12 symbol 35
859    /// left of it.
860    #[cfg(any())]
861    fn a_refinement_refines_the_page_in_its_area_and_any_reference_where_it_is() {
862        #[derive(Default)]
863        struct Rows(Vec<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>);
864        impl Decoder for Rows {
865            fn push_pixel(&mut self, black: bool) {
866                self.1.push(u8::from(black));
867            }
868            fn push_pixel_chunk(&mut self, black: bool, chunks: u32) {
869                for _ in 0..8 * chunks {
870                    self.push_pixel(black);
871                }
872            }
873            fn next_line(&mut self) {
874                self.0.push(core::mem::take(&mut self.1));
875            }
876        }
877        fn bit(seed: u32, x: u32, y: u32) -> u8 {
878            let mut h = x.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B1).wrapping_add(y.wrapping_mul(0x85EB_CA77)).wrapping_add(seed.wrapping_mul(0xC2B2_AE3D));
879            h ^= h >> 15;
880            h = h.wrapping_mul(0x2C1B_3C6D);
881            h ^= h >> 12;
882            h = h.wrapping_mul(0x297A_2D39);
883            h ^= h >> 15;
884            ((h >> 7) & 1) as u8
885        }
886        // About one pixel in eight: where a refinement differs from its reference.
887        let flipped = |seed: u32, x: u32, y: u32| bit(seed, x, y) & bit(seed + 1, x, y) & bit(seed + 2, x, y);
888        // A page of bit(1, ..), and over it at 41, 4 the area refined from it.
889        const PAGE: &str = "000000003000010000001300000070000000180000000000000000420000000000012600010000016f00000070000000180000000000000000040003fffdff02fefefefb5d354db053c2a984c01af66c619b02c245055be23a2a431b04c60325c88676f6ff1b0a68c873ad9011a27a89fc99abc7db2e8f529ecf198ff8c6a726ddcb746dc51f3812e365e74ee668fa02f59182cae39f0ef43b3201da1bcd43a21f449889e15ba0ba1a9344da1bdb9dcb4015279a39d944509febc622a235fa2c623acb443f0c10dabf7fba5e9d6fef2f1289dfd0a6a3801d036f21a62045074f5d3158ab0373ad2334102ef867dc3132dc8d02fe517771c419cdbad47d67d409ec89d0425d1f51a48af6ba3bee6e0701185bfa5f46b347b0ec39e744b665d1e8aac868838d3db25162d65534ff4771d9c0d657bd48d5814fa7cc184d0e961defab2d75a79a88345cdae5546a54221a22ddfe9c8a0514f32ac9de806fbc5fb4f5275c79d679f0258f77900daaa273cee50e50c958f323414670d7761418639342fdb2082eac5e7934f1a06169991452b1a042eaee7871ffac000000022a000100000091000000400000001000000029000000040400ffffffffd24567306e52f57232cefa9800db00fb60c21b30b0e53d9fac8a1f863a580a7cc49ab401934ac8be3a18e2dc0f01774b76c3e9196283cb5504742c763a867bc1aae8c48d74d194dacda03ce7e91904897ab61add273d9188fda65dc6fefb995d85f48142e43c1970bedb9c5f4be3cb00d458e9f4ee9714a61fffac";
890        let page: Vec<Vec<u8>> = (0..24)
891            .map(|y| {
892                (0..112).map(|x| bit(1, x, y) ^ if (41..105).contains(&x) && (4..20).contains(&y) { flipped(10, x - 41, y - 4) } else { 0 }).collect()
893            })
894            .collect();
895        // A symbol of bit(3, ..), and a text instance refined from it, 70 narrower with RDX 0.
896        const TEXT: &str = "0000000030000100000013000000460000000c000000000000000042000000000001000001000000ed000003fffdff02fefefe00000001000000013f4efc0ce48e6b5c00246a648400fb605a44d542ed29da2b9b55c01f4e5af9842dd70c88f4913c7f552503ba52a5d7b5d9fd08ff5794b4dbfb3df7bafcf9c43d04154c1cefa181ca1aba5da826a4e4229858bd0950442df69c098ab3b61a32f71b136974b96bcb5306f3e75af1a4ef51b8f56a355acb8b69915cfa623f5a21933be8c056a348783a116ea914e886af2c64bf3b23e5610726c981092220f05411857529861fbf4c630a15fd00b081d2351279e06602f4408b25dc1d01c223027ecb8c87c4b1d76e3882a759c1adaf749f0e20735f8bd5a7306fffac000000020620010100000085000000460000000c0000000000000000040012ffffffff00000001a967c0b129999147062a4766ce10bc3dae7f1daf43dda1427d31203a1bc9fa021e0504e0a4b01739952970b54ad11ac08c0684d2f556a1843eb01dc75b963be6237b7f02fdfe17ccf7f061de310a936fd08c5ddea47609789e55f7cbca81ae38219c4abc5f9eff47ffac";
897        let text: Vec<Vec<u8>> = (0..12).map(|y| (0..70).map(|x| bit(3, x + 35, y) ^ flipped(30, x, y)).collect()).collect();
898        for (stream, picture) in [(PAGE, page), (TEXT, text)] {
899            let stream: Vec<u8> = (0..stream.len() / 2).map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&stream[i * 2..i * 2 + 2], 16).unwrap()).collect();
900            let mut rows = Rows::default();
901            Image::new_embedded(&stream, None).unwrap().decode(&mut rows).unwrap();
902            assert_eq!(rows.0, picture);
903        }
904    }
905
906    /// PdfCraft patch: the area a refinement of the page refines is the page inside it and 0
907    /// outside: off the page's rows and columns, past where a column can be, and past the page's
908    /// width and the area's own whatever the padding of the page's rows holds. `new_with` clears
909    /// that padding (patch 13), so the page's words are set to all 1s, padding included.
910    #[cfg(any())]
911    fn a_page_area_is_the_page_inside_it_and_0_outside() {
912        let mut page = Bitmap::new_with(40, 3, 0, 0, true).unwrap();
913        page.data.fill(!0);
914        let area = |x, y, width, height| page.area(x, y, width, height).unwrap().data;
915        assert_eq!(area(30, 1, 20, 3), [0xFFC0_0000, 0xFFC0_0000, 0], "10 columns and 2 rows of the page");
916        assert_eq!(area(0, 0, 33, 1), [!0, 0x8000_0000], "the whole of a word, and none of the area's padding");
917        assert_eq!(area(36, 0, 8, 1), [0xF000_0000], "4 columns, and none of the page's padding");
918        assert_eq!(area(5, 0, 8, 1), [0xFF00_0000], "inside the page");
919        assert_eq!(area(40, 0, 8, 1), [0], "right of the page");
920        assert_eq!(area(u32::MAX - 2, 0, 40, 1), [0, 0], "past where a column can be");
921        assert_eq!(area(0, u32::MAX, 8, 2), [0, 0], "below the page");
922        assert!(area(3, 0, 0, 2).is_empty(), "no width");
923    }
924
925    /// A stream and its globals are one stream of segments, so they have one count.
926    #[cfg(any())]
927    fn the_segments_of_a_stream_and_its_globals_count_together() {
928        let segment: &[u8] = &[0, 0, 0, 0, 62, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0]; // an empty extension
929        let half = segment.repeat(1 << 19);
930        let more = segment.repeat((1 << 19) + 1);
931        let refused = |data: &[u8]| {
932            let error = Image::new_embedded(data, Some(&half)).err().map(|e| e.to_string());
933            error.as_deref() == Some("too many segments or references in a stream")
934        };
935        assert!(!refused(&half), "2^20 segments are allowed");
936        assert!(refused(&more), "one more isn't");
937    }
938
939    /// PdfCraft patch: a refinement whose reference is offset right of it reads the reference from
940    /// its first column, where it read the first 32 as 0. So that a context read wrong changes what
941    /// decodes, the refinement is large, and its picture comes from the hash it was coded from: a
942    /// 104 × 12 text instance refined from a 100 × 12 symbol 2 right of it.
943    #[cfg(any())]
944    fn a_refinement_reads_a_reference_right_of_it_from_its_first_column() {
945        #[derive(Default)]
946        struct Rows(Vec<Vec<u8>>, Vec<u8>);
947        impl Decoder for Rows {
948            fn push_pixel(&mut self, black: bool) {
949                self.1.push(u8::from(black));
950            }
951            fn push_pixel_chunk(&mut self, black: bool, chunks: u32) {
952                for _ in 0..8 * chunks {
953                    self.push_pixel(black);
954                }
955            }
956            fn next_line(&mut self) {
957                self.0.push(core::mem::take(&mut self.1));
958            }
959        }
960        fn bit(seed: u32, x: u32, y: u32) -> u8 {
961            let mut h = x.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B1).wrapping_add(y.wrapping_mul(0x85EB_CA77)).wrapping_add(seed.wrapping_mul(0xC2B2_AE3D));
962            h ^= h >> 15;
963            h = h.wrapping_mul(0x2C1B_3C6D);
964            h ^= h >> 12;
965            h = h.wrapping_mul(0x297A_2D39);
966            h ^= h >> 15;
967            ((h >> 7) & 1) as u8
968        }
969        // About one pixel in eight: where a refinement differs from its reference.
970        let flipped = |seed: u32, x: u32, y: u32| bit(seed, x, y) & bit(seed + 1, x, y) & bit(seed + 2, x, y);
971        // A symbol of bit(2, ..), and a text instance refined from it, 4 wider with RDX 0.
972        const TEXT: &str = "0000000030000100000013000000680000000c000000000000000042000000000001000001000000b1000003fffdff02fefefe00000001000000013f525ad7118f669a303f1b11efa5210e9765b834b1831c650f3a3d325dbd7317379ea4fb573b09a20c362f065d8f9301e74cbbc50c69910641c0e0eea7c2fd1e831ca1459a943be55ed8e074b426ad7ff1e8d8ff6f1aa44684de5da4b4c3483911604412e00e96a0db6ec7103feb2bc4301ae98d3f9c23078ae72dc46f76e9dfea209d39187f1194f7b9285cd6e7b2dc7abb5def43ff0abe2df554fc55ffac0000000206200101000000af000000680000000c0000000000000000040012ffffffff00000001a96b5febebec5a68693b51f5db25ddf176d4aae89904a71d1690f12888e10b038db723ac59941f76c2844b739ce524d9563f4005e1edbabf2e323e8e9ac1a3b9060587c3010e7d6bcf90c00dbf9000a2f17b1d9b598e01b9158dc16a63f4388a6f647b99dc7118aa09e08d59fba1bc24e3a0f1ebb0cae636b6bedbb65b01945228d3e5d2980a0ad6290c13d2f34f5c861415ffac";
973        let picture: Vec<Vec<u8>> =
974            (0..12).map(|y| (0..104).map(|x| (if (2..102).contains(&x) { bit(2, x - 2, y) } else { 0 }) ^ flipped(20, x, y)).collect()).collect();
975        let stream: Vec<u8> = (0..TEXT.len() / 2).map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&TEXT[i * 2..i * 2 + 2], 16).unwrap()).collect();
976        let mut rows = Rows::default();
977        Image::new_embedded(&stream, None).unwrap().decode(&mut rows).unwrap();
978        assert_eq!(rows.0, picture);
979    }
980
981    /// A dictionary being decoded has what the page may still hold, not all of it: refused only
982    /// once it is stored, its copies would already have been made.
983    #[cfg(any())]
984    fn the_room_left_shrinks_as_segments_are_stored() {
985        let mut page = PageState::default();
986        assert_eq!(page.retained_room(), MAX_RETAINED_WORDS);
987        page.retain(1000).unwrap();
988        assert_eq!(page.retained_room(), MAX_RETAINED_WORDS - 1000 - ENTRY_WORDS);
989        page.retained_words = MAX_RETAINED_WORDS;
990        assert_eq!(page.retained_room(), 0);
991    }
992
993    /// Pixels past a bitmap's edge are 0 (6.3.5.2), and a refinement reads its reference a word at
994    /// a time, so a bitmap filled with 1s has none past its width: made, and a page made again for
995    /// the next image.
996    #[cfg(any())]
997    fn a_bitmap_of_1s_has_nothing_past_its_width() {
998        assert_eq!(Bitmap::new_with(33, 2, 0, 0, true).unwrap().data, [!0, 1 << 31, !0, 1 << 31]);
999        let mut page = Bitmap::new_with(40, 1, 0, 0, false).unwrap();
1000        page.reinitialize(7, 2, true).unwrap();
1001        assert_eq!(page.data, [0xFE00_0000, 0xFE00_0000]);
1002        assert_eq!(Bitmap::new_with(64, 1, 0, 0, true).unwrap().data, [!0, !0], "words filled whole");
1003        assert!(Bitmap::new_with(0, 3, 0, 0, true).unwrap().data.is_empty(), "no width");
1004    }
1005}
